At Anant Singh's village in Bihar's Barh, the wedding of his daughter Shivangi Singh has drawn a rather different crowd — young men who have travelled hundreds of kilometres, not to celebrate with the bride and groom, but to meet the man they call 'Dada'.
Among them are two 19-year-olds from different parts of Bihar. One walked nearly 150 kilometres from Darbhanga. The other cycled around 200 kilometres from the Muzaffarpur region.
